summary: Camp in 1915, then a cupola cabin built in 1927 on Boulder Mountain near Nordman; accidentally burned in 1935 and never replaced.

facts.design: cupola cabin built in 1927, after a 1915 camp
facts.status_note: Accidentally burned down in 1935 and was never replaced

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in; no source describes access today

notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on the 1915 camp, 1927 cupola cabin and 1935 accidental fire. Record kind 'ground' fits a cupola cabin; the sources do not name a tower. Coordinates conflict in the brief: 48.75127, -116.99501 (firelookout.org list) vs 48.75992, -117.02495 (Idaho list). The second pair sits almost on Little Grass Mountain in the firelookout.org list (48.75990, -117.02470), so it may be a copied point; the story does not use coordinates. Two searches found no other account of the 1935 fire. Firelookout.com credits photos to the Fire Lookout Museum and USFS but gives no image URLs, so none are recorded.
